parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a state-coordinated campaign in which the criminal law itself reaches the trans visitor's core status: Article 390 punishes anyone who 'changes or attempts to change their sex at birth' with 5–10 years, no suspended sentences or mitigation, alongside 10–20 year terms for association (Art. 392). Enforcement is active, not paper: at least 40 arrests, 16 imprisonments including officials, described as a witch-hunt since the Feb 2026 code took effect, with judges reassigned or sanctioned for acquitting. Officials frame it in hostile cultural terms; there is no anti-discrimination protection, organisations have collapsed, and LGBTQ people are in hiding. Outed discovery therefore carries near-certain severe imprisonment with no working remedy — tier 1/2 state imposition. It falls short of the 0.05 tier only because no execution or torture pattern is documented. No trans-specific border or violence data exists, but the structural facts dominate.
